features.name: Desktop application
features.state: PARTIAL (real Electron smoke + unsigned packaged mac-arm64 app; signing/notarization/other OS NEEDS EXTERNAL VALIDATION)
features.detail: contextIsolation/sandbox, narrow preload, CSP (mutation-checked), cross-origin navigation and window.open blocked, permissions denied, raw-string deep-link regex, OS-keychain token store. 11 unit + 5 Electron tests incl. packaged Harness.app.

features.name: GitHub issue intake
features.state: VERIFIED IMPLEMENTED (local, fake GitHub); live webhook delivery NEEDS EXTERNAL VALIDATION
features.detail: HMAC-SHA256 verify, tenant from the registration (never payload), per-delivery idempotency, sliding rate limit, bot-loop ignore, trusted-association gate for /harness plan, secrets/mentions/closing-keywords neutralised, pending_approval only. Approval records a decision; run/plan creation is NEEDS INTEGRATION (A2). Persistence is lane-owned SQLite; shared Postgres migration is an A1 NEEDS INTEGRATION item. Signature check mutation-verified.

features.name: GitLab issue intake
features.state: VERIFIED IMPLEMENTED (local, fake GitLab); live delivery NEEDS EXTERNAL VALIDATION
features.detail: X-Gitlab-Token constant-time compare or Standard Webhooks signing (replay window, id-bound). Same pipeline as F037. Client blocks merge/rebase/approve/protected-branch/branch-delete, https-only api base, no credentials, no link-local, no redirects. GitLab note comments carry no access-level check (only queue for approval).

risks.note: Entry points exist; no usability measurement.
VS Code/Neovim/JetBrains/desktop entry points built; none validated in a real host/IDE except Electron.
Intake queues for human approval; no live provider journey.
Tokens never in argv/logs/repo (scan test); keychain/SecretStorage; no live credential-rotation test.
Untrusted issue text neutralised and cannot authorize; webhook flood rate-limited; no load test.
Merge-class operations blocked in GitLab client; no merge path anywhere in intake.
